dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室
dataList.content:
A terrible jest Jia Yuanchun plays, down to the very last day.
贾元春。到了最后一刻还要开这种恶劣的玩笑么。

Too much time has passed already...
已经过去很长时间了……

I have already given her clan, including Wei, instructions to keep their eyes on the Palanquin, as I observed much strangeness from the Palanquin bearers...
我已经注意到轿夫们有可疑的行为，也指示卫和惜春的其他下属去跟踪那顶轿子，但是……
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
... yet there are many places to which one may covertly kidnap the Family Hierarch.
可以秘密绑架家主的地点可不止一两个。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Still, we have to—!
就算这样我们也要……！

Your heart is still in a rush. I do not mean to imply that we will abandon her to fate.
不要心急。这并不意味着我们就会失去她。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Look, I have selected a few places on the map with the highest probabilities of being their destination.
看这里，我挑选出了几处可能性较高的地点。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
As the time is not on our side, the Heishou Packs and your team will have to mobilize separately to explore all possible options.
时间紧迫，你们和黑兽各自去探索可能的地点。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
Among them I aim to send you toward...
其中需要交给你们的地点是……
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
... This place.
……这里是。

Indeed. The glorified internment camp of Hongyuan, now shut down.
鸿园被封锁了的收容所。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
<ruby=Peace and Calm>Pingan</ruby> Residential Support Zone. It is a policy Jia Yuanchun and the former Jia Mu pursued.
平安住宅保障处……是以前贾元春和贾母共同推进的政策。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
The policy was indefinitely tabled and the zone was closed off, as many voiced reluctance to pass it, but I find it hard to believe that Jia Yuanchun would admit defeat so easily.
虽然由于大观园内反对的声音越来越大，导致政策被无限期搁置并封锁了该设施，但贾元春绝不会轻易放弃。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
It is a secluded place, perfect to secretly bring harm to the Family Hierarch... not to mention the symbolic value it carries.
那里不仅正好适合暗杀家主……而且还具备象征意义。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
I hope she's okay...
希望她平安无事……

Have some faith in your pupil.
各位应该对她多一些信任。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
You have taught her to the best of your abilities, have you not? I trust that she will be able to fend for herself until our arrival.
既然各位对她倾囊相授。那么她一定能坚持到各位抵达。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
... Yeah. We trained really, really hard for the entire month.
……没错。毕竟修炼了整整一个月。

The only reason Jia Yuanchun would employ such under-the-table tactics is because she knows that a fair match would not be in her favor.
贾元春知道正面突破对她不利，所以才使出了卑鄙的手段。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指

dataList.content:
So, let us yank her hand out from under the table and make her regret it.
我们只要将这一着化为恶手即可。
dataList.title:
The Pinky
小指
